howto: How to read the timeline and what the colours mean
howto_html:
Each row is one influence of the period; the bar shows the days when it is active, on the day scale at the top. Click a row to read its text.

  • Red: tense aspects (square, opposition). Two forces pull in different directions: friction, load, arguments, a wish to change everything. It is not a disaster but pressure to act: tension gives energy if you put it into work rather than into a fight.
  • Blue: harmonious aspects (trine, sextile). The forces support each other: what comes easier on these days, such as conversations, decisions, rest and new starts. The ease does not act on its own: it is worth using.
  • Accent colour: conjunctions, New Moons and Full Moons. Two forces merge and the theme comes to the front; its character depends on the planets. The accent colour is taken from your chart.
  • Grey: a planet moving through a house, the area of life where its theme is unfolding now.
  • Pink dashes: retrograde motion, a time to review and rework things in the area of that house.
  • A dot is the moment of the exact aspect, the peak of the influence. A ring means the planet turns around on this point: the theme sounds stronger and lasts longer. A bar running to the edge of the scale means the influence started earlier or goes on after the period.
